mostWorthwhile.text: Collecting liquid methane was the clearest payoff: an actual product emerged from the earlier fuel-making process.

leastWorthwhile.text: Connecting the oxygen felt somewhat repetitive after the methane, though separate handling had a clear purpose.

surprise.text: Combining the two tanks coordinated their controls rather than mixing their contents; the result made that distinction explicit.

arbitrary.text: The final tank-to-tank combination initially felt abstract because coordinating controls was not apparent from the pair alone, though the result explained it.

continue.text: Yes. The return plant provides a useful milestone, and I would be curious to see how the preserved discovery reaches Earth.
